entities.name: Frank M. Warren, Sr.

entities.summary: Frank Manley Warren Sr. was a prominent American businessman from Oregon who made his fortune in the salmon canning industry. The community of Warrendale, Oregon, the site of one of his canneries, was named for him. He died in the sinking of Titanic.
